title: Next one's on me
setting: A few days later, at a coffee counter. This is the 'next one' Maya promised after covering Chris.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Don't touch that. Next one's on me.
lines.spoken: Don't touch that. Next one's on me.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I didn't even—I was just looking at it.
lines.spoken: I didn't even—I was just looking at it.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I saw your hand. I'm serious.
lines.spoken: I saw your hand. I'm serious.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Okay. Thank you. You want to get a table, or just do this at the counter?
lines.spoken: Okay. Thank you. You wanna get a table, or just do this at the counter?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Counter's fine. What are you getting?
lines.spoken: Counter's fine. What are you getting?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I was going to do a coffee and, I don't know, maybe that egg sandwich.
lines.spoken: I was gonna do a coffee and, I dunno, maybe that egg sandwich.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Get the sandwich. I told you I was getting this.
lines.spoken: Get the sandwich. I told you I was getting this.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: You always say that, and then I still end up—
lines.spoken: You always say that, and then I still end up—

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Not today. You forgot your wallet, I covered you, this is the next one. That's the deal.
lines.spoken: Not today. You forgot your wallet, I covered you, this is the next one. That's the deal.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. That's the deal. I appreciate it.
lines.spoken: Yeah. That's the deal. I appreciate it.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You're welcome. You wanna just order for both of us? I'll go grab napkins.
lines.spoken: You're welcome. You wanna just order for both of us? I'll go grab napkins.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. You want the usual? The oat whatever?
lines.spoken: Yeah. You want the usual? The oat whatever?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: The oat whatever, yes. And if they ask, I'm paying. Tell them before you even start.
lines.spoken: The oat whatever, yes. And if they ask, I'm paying. Tell 'em before you even start.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Don't 'yes ma'am' me. Just let me pay.
lines.spoken: Don't 'yes ma'am' me. Just lemme pay.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I will. I won't even look at the machine.
lines.spoken: I will. I won't even look at the machine.

gist.askZh: 这趟咖啡是谁请客？为什么？
accept: because she covered him last time

gist.askZh: 他们是坐下来点，还是在柜台点？
gist.askEn: Are they sitting down or ordering at the counter?

details.askEn: What is Chris thinking of getting?

details.askZh: Maya 交代他怎么跟店员说？
details.askEn: What should Chris tell the cashier?
accept: 告诉他们是 Maya 付

glue.span: I was going to do a coffee
glue.hear: I was gonna do a coffee
glue.noteZh: was going to 缩成 was gonna，do a 又弱，整段像 I was gonna do uh coffee。
glue.standard: I was going to do a coffee

glue.hear: You wanna just order for both of us

glue.standard: You want to just order for both of us

glue.noteZh: 又是 tell 'em，before you 中间 you 很弱，不要只抓住 tell 和 start。
glue.standard: Tell them before you even start

I saw your hand. I'm serious.

chunks.meaningZh: 就这么说好了 / 这是我们的约定。
chunks.sayAfter: I covered you, this is the next one. That's the deal.

roleplay.setupZh: 这是你答应过的‘下一次’。你们在咖啡店柜台前，对方又习惯性地要去拿钱或看机器。你要把这次请客落实。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, easygoing, slightly sheepish. He will joke, say 'yes ma'am,' and try to cooperate. He still has the habit of reaching for his card.
variants: The cashier asks them who is paying.
Chris tries to add a pastry and gets shy about it.
Maya has to take a call and asks Chris to order for both.
starters: Don't touch that. Next one's on me.
You wanna just order for both of us?

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这趟咖啡：为什么轮到 Maya 请，他们在柜台怎么分工，Maya 交代了什么。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the coffee-counter story: why it's Maya's turn, how they split the ordering, and what she told Chris to say. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
